title: spec review: Active path 3: handoff-aware executor routing (start strong when expected route cost says so) within pool constraints (v2)
spec:
Today (T-0831) [handoff] mode "active" is treated as shadow: executor.start records a "handoff" decision with expected_route_cost per eligible executor but launches the baseline pick. Build the active branch. Facts: executor.start picks via pool.pick_executor + allocation (executor.py ~276-323); handoff_scorecard.expected_route_cost(task_class, executor, root, cfg) returns a number or {"insufficient": True}; promotion CRITERIA min_samples 20.
Do:
1. Active: after the baseline pick, when every eligible executor has sufficient samples for the task's class and the lowest expected_route_cost executor differs from the baseline by more than [handoff] min_gain (new key, default 0.15 = 15% cheaper expected cost-to-accept), launch that executor instead; record the decision row with selected = the chosen executor and reason "expected_route_cost" plus the gain; otherwise keep the baseline with reason "insufficient_evidence" or "gain_below_threshold". Hard pool constraints (eligibility, cooldowns, complexity ceilings such as Astra for ≥9, budgets) stay authoritative: the router only chooses among pool.eligible_executors.
2. Cap: at most [handoff] max_active_share (default 0.5) of the day's execute launches may deviate from the baseline, so the baseline keeps producing comparison data; count per day in pool_state or the decision log.
3. Outcome feedback: when a task started under an active handoff decision reaches merged or failed, decision_log.outcome(task, "handoff", ...) records rounds, accepted tokens and usd; handoff_scorecard.by_start already aggregates by first executor, add a column "active_share".
Tests: tests/test_executor.py::test_active_handoff_switches_executor_when_gain_exceeds_threshold, ::test_active_handoff_keeps_baseline_without_evidence, ::test_active_share_cap_enforced; tests/test_handoff_scorecard.py::test_active_outcome_rows_feed_by_start; docs/context-economy/08-handoffs.md Active section with the revert path ([handoff] mode shadow).
Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.

SPEC v2 (2026-09-22 23:05) after spec review T-0851 (request_changes), binding on top of v1:
- No daemon hook. executor.start stamps `pipeline.handoff` = {"baseline", "selected", "switched": bool, "gain", "reason", "ts"} on the bus task at dispatch (inside bus.locked()). handoff_scorecard.lineage_rows/by_start read that stamp from the task rows they already load: active_share = switched lineages / lineages with a stamp, and outcomes (rounds, accepted tokens, usd, merged/failed) come from the same task and run rows the module already aggregates. orchestrator/daemon.py leaves the scope; no decision_log.outcome call is required (the decision row is written once at dispatch with the final reason).
- Decision reasons: "expected_route_cost" (switched), "insufficient_evidence", "gain_below_threshold", "cap_reached" (evidence and gain justify a switch but the day's active share is full), "allocation_active" (see precedence). Tests assert each reason is auditable from the decision row alone.
- Day counter: computed under bus.locked() from task rows stamped today (pipeline.handoff.switched and ts within the local day) immediately before stamping; the count and the stamp happen in the same locked block, so concurrent dispatchers cannot overshoot max_active_share by more than one.
- Precedence: baseline = the executor start() is about to launch after the allocation layer (the post-allocation pick). When [allocation] mode is active, handoff never overrides it: it records the decision with reason "allocation_active" and keeps the pick. When allocation is shadow or off, handoff may switch. Document this in 08-handoffs.md.
- tests/test_handoff_scorecard.py::test_active_outcome_rows_feed_by_start is replaced by ::test_active_share_and_outcomes_from_task_stamps (two lineages, one switched; by_start shows active_share 0.5 and the switched lineage's outcome), and tests/test_executor.py gains ::test_handoff_yields_to_active_allocation.
acceptance: docs/context-economy/08-handoffs.md has an Active section; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

risks.issue: decision_log.record("handoff", ...) at line 330-336 hardcodes reason="shadow: routing unchanged" regardless of mode. Once active switching is added, this call still fires for both shadow and active (line 323: `if mode in ("shadow","active")`) and would log a false reason for switched/gain_below_threshold/cap_reached/allocation_active decisions, since the spec's new decision reasons live only in the pipeline.handoff stamp, not in this existing decision_log call. Spec doesn't say whether to update, repoint, or delete this call.

notify.notify_once(task_id, "handoff_active_shadow", f"...handoff active is observation-only; routing unchanged") at line 337-339 becomes false once active mode actually switches executors. docs/context-economy/08-handoffs.md currently states 'The current active value is also observation-only and emits a warning' — both the notify message and this doc sentence must be replaced, but the spec's acceptance criteria only requires an 'Active section' to be added, not this stale sentence removed.

Spec introduces [handoff] min_gain and max_active_share as 'new keys' but doesn't say whether they must be added to pool.toml with explicit defaults or may live only as code-level .get(...,default) fallbacks. Scope lists pool.toml as touched, so leaving the keys implicit-only would technically satisfy tests but leave the config file undocumented for operators, inconsistent with every other tunable in this file having an inline comment.

suggested_spec_changes: State explicitly whether the existing decision_log.record("handoff", ...) call in executor.py should be updated to use the real per-dispatch reason/selected values, left as shadow-only bookkeeping, or removed now that pipeline.handoff is the source of truth.

Require the notify.notify_once(..., "handoff_active_shadow", ...) message and the matching sentence in docs/context-economy/08-handoffs.md ('The current active value is also observation-only and emits a warning') be rewritten or removed as part of the Active section, so the running system doesn't emit a false 'observation-only' notice after active switching ships.

Add explicit pool.toml entries for [handoff] min_gain = 0.15 and max_active_share = 0.5 with a one-line comment, matching the convention used by every other tunable in that file (e.g. [allocation] min_samples, latency_weight_usd_per_hour).
